---
name: ADR proposal
about: Propose an implementation decision that does not change any constitutional document
title: "[ADR] "
labels: adr
---

Before filing, read [`docs/adr/README.md`](../../docs/adr/README.md) and
[`GOVERNANCE.md` §19](../../docs/GOVERNANCE.md#19-architecture-decision-records-adr).
If this decision would change what a conforming Kyne implementation is
required to do, it is a **KIP**, not an ADR — use the
[KIP proposal template](./kip_proposal.md) instead.

## Context

What implementation question needs deciding, and why it needs deciding
now.

## Decision

The specific choice being proposed.

## Consequences

What this decision affects, and what it does not.

## Affected crate(s) / area

Which crate(s) or subsystem this ADR's decision applies to, and who owns
them per that crate's own `README.md`.
